comment: The quality of this professor and her class does not reflect the quality of this institution. Grading techniques were unexplained, with no rubrics and bad feedback. She does not seem very knowledgeable about the topic and struggles to answer questions in class. Also, I think her slides are ChatGPT-generated. Save your time!!!

Most unclear grading criteria ever. Unrealistic expectations for project turnaround times and the midterm. Syllabus does not outline everything. Often cannot answer questions properly and students are left confused. Does not seem extremely well educated. Save yourself and take anyone else!

I got a higher grade on the midterm than I got on the final and I did not spend a single second studying for the midterm, unsure how that worked out the way that it did but this class was quite awful. This is the first and last psychology class I will be taking at UR, spare yourself the trouble and take Webster.

Super nice professor, but she cannot answer questions in PSYC 200. Maybe she's better with other classes where the material is more interesting, but with the stats stuff, you have to rephrase your question multiple times before she'll understand what you're trying to ask & gives the most vague answer in response.

Overall, I enjoyed Dr. Nonterah's Women's Health course but some things could use some major. improvements. Grading criteria/ instructions are very vague for papers and major assignments. Lots of reading, weekly reading assessments. Be sure to participate and ask questions abt assignments to stay on track. Major group project as final... good luck.

Dr. Nonterah's seminar was pretty interesting, but it was also very reading and writing-heavy. Some more time-consuming homework and projects for sure and sometimes they don't have the clearest guidelines but the main thing she likes to see is effort in assignments. Participation does matter a lot and she is very caring and knowledgable.

Course focused on women's health. She does not provide the clearest of guidelines, which may be frustrating. Weekly reading assessments and a community outreach project. Class discussions on the readings. Book is mandatory costs, like upwards of $80.

Lack of clarity for assignments. We had weekly homework with no guidelines, and they weren't graded until months into the semester so I didn't know I was losing points every week. A lot of reading for stuff we don't really get graded or tested on. Expectations for midterm /final are EXTREME!!! Seems to be a disconnect with students' time/capability
LOL what a joke. Spare yourself the trouble.

Dr. Nonterah is really caring and understanding, and participation is VERY emphasized for her. As long as you are participating and keeping up with the work, the class goes smoothly. Though she can be unclear when it comes to grading criteria and expectations, but doesn't grade too harshly if you make an effort.

Dr. Nonterah is incredibly passionate, kind, smart, and excellent. She is the best psychology professor in the department. I've learned so much thanks to her class. The material is engaging and interesting. She grades the assignments very quickly, always gives great feedback, and is fair in her grading. Everyone should take this course!

Dr. Nonterah is easily one of the best professors Ive had at Richmond. She is really caring and her material is super engaging. There are a lot of writing assignments, but no tests. Participation is really easy given the structure of the class. Even though she takes her time grading, she is always open to discussing your position in the class.

Really liked her at the beginning of the semester but this class is actually horrible. Just did not grade anything. Very stressful. Super hard to follow. Material was interesting but she just stressed me out and lecture was always disorganized.

Dr. Nonterah is super nice but does not do a good job conveying the material. She assigns projects with no instruction, and at the end of the semester, she still has not graded the midterms and other old assignments so I have no idea what my grade is. There are several large readings per week and lab is often a continuation of lecture. Disorganized

If you want to take a class where you literally have no direction whatsoever, take this one. Dr. Nonterah is a nice professor, but she gives no guidelines for expectations in assignments and assigns so much work. Sometimes you have to ask her to post the rubric for how she wants it done. She will also never grade your work. Don't take this class.
Dr. Nonterah is a pretty easy Professor and I really liked her class. If you come prepared to class and do the readings then you will do great!
Unclear grading criteria, never prepared for class, class is so boring, not clear with her expectations or intentions at all
